svg.title: Loblaw online grocery pay checklist
svg.desc: Checklist before hitting pay on PC Express: offers loaded, fee vs pass, produce risk, Flashfood still in-store.
svg.text: Hit pay only after this Loblaw online check
PC Express is convenient. It is not a Flashfood substitute and it is not automatically cheaper than No Frills.

g.text: PC Optimum offers loaded on the same SKUs as checkout
Fee math: future pickup ~$1 vs same-day delivery vs a $99.99 pass
Compare five staples to Flipp. Online-only pricing is not a flyer win
Produce you care about, and Flashfood meat, stay a store visit
Card / gift-card stack still pay-in-full. Insiders Pass is a fee product

svg.text: Public 2026 explainers: Express Pass $9.99/mo or $99.99/yr. Confirm the slot on your order. Saving Optimizer - 20 Sep 2026.
